pilot_exclusion: Na/Cu(001) is a development pilot and is excluded from the independently selected validation cohort.
candidate_universe_requirements: surface diffusion or elementary surface reaction with a tractable periodic cell
required elements available in the frozen pseudopotential family
publicly identifiable system, surface face, and mechanism
no screening on whether the reported barrier, rate, friction, or turnover appears favorable
computational resource estimate within the declared project ceiling
selection_method: hash the frozen eligible candidate list, record a random seed, then perform random or stratified-random selection before reading outcome-bearing numerical literature for the selected systems
versioning_rule: Any scientific engine change after cohort selection creates a new engine version and requires rerunning all previously calculated validation systems under that version.
